system.flavor: Rifle-propelled fragmentation grenade. Load into a Grenade Launcher.
system.notes:
THE BOOK, TEXT-LAYER VERIFIED 2026-08-27 (CP2020 Core, text layer only).

The launcher fires the ORDINARY grenade types; there is no separate list of launcher-only warheads. Core p.111, verbatim: "All grenade types are available in hand or rifle-propelled versions, and are described in the Area Effect Weapons & Grenade Table, pg. 89." And, same page: "Grenades may be thrown up to 1 Ox the character's Body Type in meters (-1 Om for every extra kg. past the initial 1 ), or launched to a range of 225 meters."

Core p.64 HEAVY WEAPONS, the two entries, verbatim: "Grenade / HVY O P P Varies 1 1 VR / Types include Fragmentation (7D6), Incendiary (4D6 for 3 turns), Stun (-5 to Stun), Dazzle (Blind for 4 turns), Sonic (deafened 4 turns), Gas (see FNFF Gas Table)." and "Grenade Launchers / HVY O L/N R Varies 1 1 ST / Launcher may be attached (under barrel) to any assault rifle, or hand-held. Range 225m, Cost l 50eb. Not compatible with Militech RPG-A."

So: the launcher's own damage is the word "Varies" because the ROUND carries the warhead; shots and ROF are both 1; the launched range is 225 m. Damage here is the printed Fragmentation figure, 7D6.

INFERRED, NOT PRINTED: the per-round COST. The HEAVY WEAPONS price column of the p.61-62 weapons table has NO TEXT LAYER in the reference PDF and image-only tables are not read here, so this round mirrors the base pack's thrown Fragmentation Grenade instead - 30eb, 0.5 kg. The same 30eb is written onto boxSize 1 / boxCost 30 so the ammo sheet's own restock control charges for a round rather than handing one out free: "Grenade" is not a registered caliber, and an unregistered caliber falls to the "none" cost class (box 1, price 0). Blast radius is left at 0 on purpose, so the module's single book-sourced grenade area (5 m, CP2020 p.99 AREA EFFECT TABLE) answers for it and one ruling still moves every grenade at once.
